verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents first-party MCP servers: one for Cloud Run resources and the MCP Toolbox for Databases, which offers prebuilt tools and NL2SQL. These let external AI clients such as Gemini CLI or Claude Code operate parts of the product from natural-language prompts. Coverage is limited to Cloud Run and databases, and it depends on a third-party agent client rather than a native natural-language interface. Missing for 10: native natural-language command interface in the console or CLI, coverage beyond Cloud Run and databases, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
